description.zh: 资源ID列表，最大元素数量：50。
description.en: The IDs of the resources. You can specify up to 50 IDs in each request.
The resource type. Set the value to **DOMAIN**.

description.zh: 标签组合列表。最大元素数量：20。
description.en: The tags. You can specify up to 20 tags in each request.
The key of the tag. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**.
The value of the tag. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**.

descriptions.en: >  The maximum number of times that each user can call this operation per second is 10.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn describe-tag-resources --resource-type DOMAIN --resource-id example.com --tag Value=value Key=key --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cdn DescribeTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'example.com' --Tag.1.Key key --Tag.1.Value value --ResourceType DOMAIN
